released_boundary: Gridline Developer Studio Shell v1 — a native SwiftUI macOS application shell that renders typed developer-workflow projection states and emits typed user intents, while performing no GitHub, filesystem, AgentLoop, context-engine, inference, evidence-validation, or publication authority actions inside SwiftUI. The shell consumes E0 three-surface architecture (Gridline, project page, portfolio surfaces) and distinguishes fixture-backed, deferred, blocked, degraded, corrupt, review-required, and published states.
stated_consumer_purpose: A developer can launch the macOS app, enter the Carte Blanche/repository/project workflow using real backend projections or clearly identified service-backed fixture mode, and inspect a project-page candidate without UI code bypassing domain authority.
fixture_backed_status: The shell remains fixture-backed for all J0/K0/L0/M0 workflow states despite those lanes being published on remote. All five product area views display DeferredServiceBannerView for unreleased service boundaries. FixtureModeBannerView marks every view. AppState status message says 'DEVELOPMENT — Fixture mode. No live backend connected.' No live service adapter is claimed by N0.
